title: High-Impact Customer Sprint-Admit Protocol with Scoped Rollforward
text:
High-Impact Customer Sprint-Admit Protocol with Scoped Rollforward

description:
Define and pilot a lightweight, time-boxed admission protocol for inbound top-account requests that require an expedited commit window. Purpose: reduce decision latency for high-impact escalations while preserving sprint predictability and scope discipline.

objectives:
Cut triage-to-commit decision time for top-account escalations to <= 10 business days
Provide a deterministic fallback (scoped rollforward) when full deliverables cannot be committed within the sprint
Create clear signals for Eng/Design/CS handoffs so implementation can start within 48 hours of admission

success_metrics:
Median time from intake to roadmap commit <= 10 business days
% of admitted items that start implementation within 48 hours >= 90%
% of rollforward cases with defined MVP scope and agreement >= 100%
Reduction in ad-hoc re-prioritizations for top-account lanes by 30% over Q2

acceptance_criteria:
A documented intake checklist and decision rubric published in Confluence
A pilot cohort of 5 top accounts with intake flows instrumented in HubSpot and Jira
Playbook includes explicit rollback/rollforward clauses and owner assignments
Console and roadmap dashboards updated to show admission state and expected commit window

implementation_notes:
We will run a 6-week pilot with the Customer Success east cohort. Triage panel will include PM, Tech Lead, and Solutions SE. Use pre-existing SLA tiers and a small engineering carve-out for true P0 work. Avoid changing core backlog prioritization policies — this protocol overlays existing lanes and provides time-boxed exceptions.

tasks:
Draft intake rubric (PM) - due 2026-02-18
Design admit state UI in Console (Design) - due 2026-02-25
Eng feasibility assessment template (Eng) - due 2026-03-01
Instrument intake form and tracking fields in Jira (PM/Eng) - due 2026-03-05
Run pilot with 5 accounts and collect metrics (CS/PM) - run window 2026-03-08 to 2026-04-15
Post-pilot review and decision (Exec/PM) - due 2026-04-22

recent_updates:
2026-02-12: Initial scoping session with CS, Eng, and Design. Decided on 6-week pilot and 5-account cohort.
2026-02-18: Rubric draft completed; requested minor language edits from Legal regarding contractual commitments.
2026-02-24: Design mockups for admit-state banner reviewed. Feedback: use fewer CTAs and add clear owner label.
2026-02-28: Eng raised concern about dedicated carve-out capacity. Follow-up: quantify expected engineering-hours per admitted item.
2026-03-01: Pilot kick-off checklist finalized. CS ready to seed first two accounts next week.

reviewers_feedback:
Marco Chen (Eng): Prefers explicit cap on engineering commitment per sprint (suggest 2 engineer-weeks).
Renee Alvarez (Legal): Ensure any timeline commitments are non-binding unless covered by SLA amendment.
Jonah Reed (CS): Suggests a customer-facing intake acknowledgement email template to set expectations.
Priya Nair (Design): UI must surface 'admit reason' and 'expected delivery window' without increasing cognitive load.

risks:
Risk: Over-indexing on top-account asks could erode sprint predictability. Mitigation: strict cap and rollforward rules.
Risk: Customers may interpret admission as contractual commitment. Mitigation: Legal-approved language on intake acknowledgements.
Risk: Engineering capacity disagreement between teams. Mitigation: pre-agreed carve-out budget and escalation path.

next_steps:
Finalize engineering budget template with Tech Leads (owner: Marco Chen) - by 2026-03-05
Legal to sign off on intake acknowledgement language (owner: Renee Alvarez) - by 2026-03-08
CS to nominate pilot accounts and schedule intake calls (owner: Jonah Reed) - by 2026-03-10

notes_for_review:
Looking for alignment on: (1) the exact engineering cap per sprint, (2) customer-facing language that avoids contractual ambiguity, (3) telemetry to capture admit->start latency. PM will synthesize review comments into final playbook version.

communication_plan:
Internal: Slack announcement to #product and #eng on pilot start (owner: PM) - day 0
Customer: Personalized email to pilot accounts with intake expectations (owner: CS) - within 48 hours of admit
Executive: Bi-weekly status in GTM sync with KPIs (owner: PM)
